faqs.question: Can I use salicylic acid body wash everyday?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend using this body wash for back acne once a day, every day.

faqs.question: Is salicylic acid good for all skin types?
faqs.answer: Yes - this body wash can be used by all skin types.

faqs.question: Will this salicylic acid body wash remove my back acne and spots?
faqs.answer: This body wash helps calm inflamed skin and prevent formation of back acne.

faqs.question: Will this salicylic acid body wash cause rash or irritation?
faqs.answer: This body wash is safe to use on normal, oily and combination skin. It won't cause any side effects like rashes or irritation but since every skin is different, if you experience any of these symptoms, please consult an expert.

faqs.question: Is salicylic acid good for body wash?
faqs.answer: Salicylic Acid is a potent BHA which gently exfoliates skin and removes impurities. This makes salicylic acid a much-recommended ingredient in any body wash.

faqs.question: What body wash do dermatologists recommend?
faqs.answer: For people with textured/acne-prone skin - dermatologists recommend bodywashes/soaps with salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide.

faqs.question: What does salicylic acid do for skin?
faqs.answer: Salicylic Acid gently dissolves dead skin cells and unclogs clogged pores. This helps deep cleanse the skin.

faqs.question: Is salicylic acid good for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: 1% Salicylic Acid is a potent formula that all skin types can use. If you're someone with sensitive skin, we'd recommend doing a patch test before including it in your routine.

faqs.question: What skin type should not use salicylic acid?
faqs.answer: We wouldn't recommend people with very dry skin to use salicylic acid.

faqs.question: Will this salicylic acid body wash lighten skin?
faqs.answer: No, this or any other body wash won't lighten the skin.
